review.hypothesis: The earlier sharper target worsened Public; a broader soft target may regularize ambiguous low-contrast foveal labels and reduce severe localization errors.
review.against: Broader targets can reduce precision and amplify the known radius4 decoding bias; the sharp-target result does not prove the reverse intervention will work.
